{{Top}}
A '''colony ship''' was a specialized [[Starship/Legends|starship]] tasked with transporting colonists to new [[Planet/Legends|planets]] to settle them and begin new communities.

''[[Outbound Flight]]'' was a colony ship that was designed to transport 50,000 colonists on a several year journey away from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="OBF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>

The [[Revan Mythologies]] credited the colony ships from [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] with the discoveries of [[Empress Teta/Legends|Koros Major]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref>
